records.context: wgpu (Vulkan, Metal, Direct3D 12) is a default dependency, but a computer without it is a supported install: the view then draws with OpenGL (VisPy) or the CPU. A missing wgpu is therefore a ``PASS``; only a wgpu that is installed and cannot be imported is a ``WARN``.

records.source: wgpu (Vulkan, Metal, Direct3D 12) is a default dependency, but a computer without it is a supported install: the view then draws with OpenGL (VisPy) or the CPU. A missing wgpu is therefore a ``PASS``; only a wgpu that is installed and cannot be imported is a ``WARN``.
records.translation: wgpu（Vulkan、Metal、Direct3D 12）是默认依赖项，但未安装它的计算机也属于受支持的安装情况：此时视图使用 OpenGL（VisPy）或 CPU 绘制。因此，缺少 wgpu 的结果是 ``PASS``；只有已安装但无法导入的 wgpu 才会得到 ``WARN``。

records.context: :func:`render_volume`, ray-marched on the GPU through wgpu (WGSL).

records.source: :func:`render_volume`, ray-marched on the GPU through wgpu (WGSL).
records.translation: :func:`render_volume`，通过 wgpu（WGSL）在 GPU 上使用射线步进进行渲染。

records.context: The third renderer of the same frame: Vulkan, Metal or Direct3D 12 by the adapter it is given. The same rays (:class:`VolumeRays`), renderings, finishes and lens as :func:`render_volume` and :class:`GLVolumeRenderer`; one compute invocation walks one ray. Volumes are read with ``textureLoad`` and interpolated in the shader exactly as :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` does (``order=1``, edges repeated), image layers add up, labels layers are laid over them in stack order, and each labels layer writes the object nearest the viewer under each ray for picking. The frame is drawn into a storage buffer, scaled to the picture's size and read back, so it lands under the same matplotlib axes as the CPU's.
records.label: spacr.layers.WGPUVolumeRenderer#1
records.source: The third renderer of the same frame: Vulkan, Metal or Direct3D 12 by the adapter it is given. The same rays (:class:`VolumeRays`), renderings, finishes and lens as :func:`render_volume` and :class:`GLVolumeRenderer`; one compute invocation walks one ray. Volumes are read with ``textureLoad`` and interpolated in the shader exactly as :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` does (``order=1``, edges repeated), image layers add up, labels layers are laid over them in stack order, and each labels layer writes the object nearest the viewer under each ray for picking. The frame is drawn into a storage buffer, scaled to the picture's size and read back, so it lands under the same matplotlib axes as the CPU's.
records.translation: 同一帧的第三种渲染器：根据传入的适配器使用 Vulkan、Metal 或 Direct3D 12。它使用的射线（:class:`VolumeRays`）、渲染方式、表面效果和透镜与 :func:`render_volume` 和 :class:`GLVolumeRenderer` 相同；一次计算调用遍历一条射线。体数据通过 ``textureLoad`` 读取，并在着色器中按照与 :func:`scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates` 完全相同的方式插值（``order=1``，重复边界值）。图像图层相加，标签图层按堆叠顺序覆盖在其上，每个标签图层为每条射线记录距离观察者最近的对象，以供对象选取。帧被绘制到存储缓冲区，缩放至图像尺寸后回读，因此会显示在与 CPU 渲染结果相同的 matplotlib 坐标轴中。

records.context: ``auto`` and ``cpu`` always; ``vulkan``, ``metal`` and ``d3d12`` when wgpu is installed and finds an adapter of that kind (:func:`spacr.layers.wgpu_adapters`, which imports wgpu the first time and never before); ``opengl`` when VisPy (a spaCR dependency) is importable. With the GPU turned off (:func:`volume_gpu_refusal`) only ``auto`` and ``cpu``. Whether a backend really draws is only known when the first frame is drawn; :meth:`_VolumeStage._active_backend` finds out, and Auto falls back along :func:`volume_backend_chain`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.volume_render_backends#1
records.source: ``auto`` and ``cpu`` always; ``vulkan``, ``metal`` and ``d3d12`` when wgpu is installed and finds an adapter of that kind (:func:`spacr.layers.wgpu_adapters`, which imports wgpu the first time and never before); ``opengl`` when VisPy (a spaCR dependency) is importable. With the GPU turned off (:func:`volume_gpu_refusal`) only ``auto`` and ``cpu``. Whether a backend really draws is only known when the first frame is drawn; :meth:`_VolumeStage._active_backend` finds out, and Auto falls back along :func:`volume_backend_chain`.
records.translation: 始终提供 ``auto`` 和 ``cpu``；安装了 wgpu 且找到相应类型的适配器时提供 ``vulkan``、``metal`` 和 ``d3d12``（:func:`spacr.layers.wgpu_adapters`，仅在首次调用时导入 wgpu，绝不会提前导入）；能够导入 VisPy（spaCR 的依赖项）时提供 ``opengl``。禁用 GPU 时（:func:`volume_gpu_refusal`）仅提供 ``auto`` 和 ``cpu``。只有绘制第一帧时才能知道后端是否确实能绘制；:meth:`_VolumeStage._active_backend` 会进行判断，Auto 则沿 :func:`volume_backend_chain` 尝试备用后端。

records.source: An install that left wgpu out (its installer profile records ``without_wgpu``) is upgraded with uv's ``--override`` of :func:`spacr.install_profile.no_wgpu_override`, so the update leaves it out too.
records.translation: 对于安装时省略了 wgpu 的情况（安装配置记录中记有 ``without_wgpu``），升级时会使用 uv 的 ``--override``（由 :func:`spacr.install_profile.no_wgpu_override` 提供），以便更新后也继续省略它。
